Over 400 American AI Data Centers Use As Much Electricity As Wisconsin, Michigan, or Indiana

America’s hyperscale data centers together use as much electricity as some entire U.S. states and produce millions of metric tons of carbon dioxide over the course of a year, according to a new study published Monday in Nature Sustainability . The number of hyperscale data centers, which are larger and more powerful than traditional data centers, and are often used to train and run large-scale AI models , has exploded in recent years.
